model_features.definition: Sine of 2*pi*local_hour/24.

model_features.definition: Sine of 2*pi*(local_day_of_year-1)/365.25.

model_features.name: day_of_year_cos
model_features.definition: Cosine of 2*pi*(local_day_of_year-1)/365.25.
